coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0/I) record. Population is 'high-grade glioma' throughout (conditions, title, eligibility, arm labels); glioblastoma is not named anywhere, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified (fails S5). Coded in full regardless. Temozolomide is not a registered intervention but is implied as concurrent standard therapy for MGMT-methylated newly diagnosed patients (Cohort A); listed as soc_backbone for Cohort A only. MGMT status assigns patients to Cohort A (methylated) vs Cohort B (unmethylated): enrichment, not candidate-matched. Tumour-tissue PK only in the pre-surgical arm. Radiotherapy is given in all arms (combination).
